steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each service is placed by its error budget and whether its objective is defined.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 service is over its error budget

findings.title: Over its error budget with no action
findings.fix: Record the action and its owner

findings.title: Objective has no definition
findings.fix: Define the objective and how it is measured

findings.title: Attainment does not follow from the counts

outcome.notChecked: Customer impact beyond the measured SLO.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] svc-billing.slo:12  Over its error budget with no action.
       Fix: Record the action and its owner.
[medium] svc-search.slo:19  Objective has no definition.
       Fix: Define the objective and how it is measured.
[low] svc-worker.slo:26  Attainment does not follow from the counts.
       Fix: Recompute attainment from the counts.
Not checked: Customer impact beyond the measured SLO.
pros: Flags a service over its error budget with no action, an objective with no definition, and an attainment that does not follow from the counts.
cons: Not checked: Customer impact beyond the measured SLO.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-reliability-review skill on the records for this review.
